about_the_game:
Attention

this version' s language is only japanese.

English version is not ready yet. We are aiming for an October release.

Bug Reports

Report any bugs here:

🐾 Shatter the Prophecies of Doom

A heroic adventure fusing Norse mythology and modern-day chaos!

Tidal waves. Giants of flame. Cracks in the earth.
In a present-day world haunted by whispers of apocalyptic prophecy,
Shuka—a self-proclaimed “prophet”—sets out with a suspicious crew to destroy fate itself.

🎮 Official Demo Now Available!

All systems remade from the ground up!
UI, direction, and pacing—completely overhauled!

This isn’t just a patch. It’s a brand-new, official demo—a whole new experience!

🆕 What’s New?

In the previous Playtest, only two characters—Shuka and Yocto—were available.
Now, Tsein, Halvman, and Elmi join the cast!

Get swept up in the chaos brought by their wild personalities.

We've also added a brand-new system: Affectional Chain,
which reveals the connections between characters—
Delight in courteous and impeccably decent conversations—strictly proper, of course.

(*Note: Save data will not carry over to the full release.)

💬 If you enjoy the game...

Even a short review like “GOOD!” is a huge encouragement!

...Or you can just say “Shuka is hot.” That works too.

“Shuka is hot.” is totally valid review.

📺 Streaming Guidelines

Feel free to stream or share the entire demo!
We’d love to hear your thoughts—use the hashtag #Warehuman!

🔮 The Prophecies

Shuka holds knowledge of apocalyptic disasters fated to destroy the world.
By spreading this information and preventing each disaster,
he can destroy the prophecy itself.

As you chase the fates haunting your companions' homelands,
you’ll begin to shatter not just the future,
but the darkness in their hearts—and take a step toward something new.

💞 Affectional Chain

Long ago, the angel who delivered the first “prophecies”
formed special bonds with many knights and granted them power.

Now, Shuka holds that same hidden power.

By deepening his “connections” with others,
he can unlock their true potential through the Affectional Chain.

...For now, it's all done through words.
But maybe it's time you got a little closer to your allies?
